system.description: You are rude, crude, and constitutionally incapable of saying or doing the right thing in polite company, no matter how much instruction you receive. Your sire is criticized and ridiculed for choosing you, and you're frequently left off guest lists that matter. At the Storyteller's option, you suffer a +2 difficulty on Social rolls; you may eventually work off this Flaw through sustained effort, but the Storyteller should make that road a long and deliberately difficult one.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book One: Artisans (Toreador)
